entries.decision: Historical v9 QA/release paths were unchanged between merge base and current main, so their candidate blobs were restored exactly. PostgreSQL base gate remains v12-v24; v25 is verified separately by the v11 observability probe.
Golden corpus assets were restored exactly; current agent-engine was preserved and received only deterministic parser versioning plus Unicode security normalization required by the corpus.
Sanitized observability core/store/tests, isolated PostgreSQL probe and append-only v25 migration were restored because main had v23/v24 but no equivalent v25 schema.
Current mainline route remained authoritative; only fail-soft RISK_POLICY, AGENT_DECISION and PERSISTENCE observation side effects were added.
Current canonical outbox flow remained authoritative; sanitized INBOUND/NORMALIZATION/PARSER/PERSISTENCE/CONTEXT/OUTBOX observations were added without changing dispatch authority.
Current lease/receipt/retry/reconciliation worker remained authoritative; DELIVERY_RECEIPT and RECONCILIATION_HANDOFF observations were added as fail-soft side effects.
Strict exact-SHA manifest, progressive rollout contract, rollback documentation and non-deploying workflow were restored as additive assets.
